card.title: Outdo the Effort
card.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll cook your dinners all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then when I'm better, I'll fill yours twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll bring them back full, with a bigger freezer. That should put me ahead.

mechanism: A counters received food care with larger proposed provision until even a freezer limitation becomes another gift to surpass.
confusable: Unlike equal repayment, each response must restore a comparative lead through a bigger sacrifice.
comparison: D43-a adds a larger freezer to returned meals; D43-b cancels travel to offer more work coverage.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
